product: NOAA/NSIDC G02202 v02r00; NASA Team monthly field (not the merged official CDR)
method: G02202 v02r00 NASA Team monthly field, fixed 1981-2010 climatology. Terrain triangle subdivision centroid quadrature on the sphere, weights renormalized to actual model marine support; fixed land/lake/shelf mask; strict intersection of NSIDC valid concentration 0..100 percent pixels for all available years and months, pole hole excluded. Whole missing monthly fields excluded; no inferred ice. Remap monthly concentration before applying 15% coarse-cell extent threshold. This is a same-grid statistic, not G02135 native extent CSV or the merged CDR. March20 model calendar normalized to physical year.
